answer_changes.reason: Add documented cause before existing remediation
answer_changes.before: Create/update the store.puma_default.user.fbadefault.filter custom property for the WP PumaStoreService Resource Environment Provider via the Integrated Solutions Console to an attribute that exists for all Portal users in the backend user registry (for example, "cn").
answer_changes.after:
Authenticated user does not have the attribute defined in the backend user registry which matches the attribute defined in the store.puma_default.user.fbadefault.filter property in WP PumaStoreService Resource Environment Provider.

Create/update the store.puma_default.user.fbadefault.filter custom property for the WP PumaStoreService Resource Environment Provider via the Integrated Solutions Console to an attribute that exists for all Portal users in the backend user registry (for example, "cn").

answer_changes.reason: Complete version-specific Java support using the supplied historical IBM document
answer_changes.before: IBM BPM V8.5.6 and V8.5.7 support Java 6 and Java 7, but do not support Java 8.
answer_changes.after:
IBM BPM V8.5.6 and V8.5.7 support Java 6 and Java 7, but do not support Java 8.

IBM BPM V8.6 supports Java 8. Java snippets, Java conditions, and Java expressions in BPEL processes must use Java 6 constructs instead of Java 7 or Java 8 constructs.
